title: Gov: No firearm but faulty wiring in Sultan Kudarat school ‘shooting’
summary: MANILA, Philippines — No shooting took place at a high school in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, after a ‘loud sound’ was reported on the premises, the province’s governor said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — No shooting took place at a high school in Isulan, Sultan Kudarat, after a ‘loud sound’ was reported on the premises, the province’s governor said Wednesday.
